name: Circle
description: Circle is a hosted community platform for discussions, memberships, courses, events, chat, live sessions, access groups, and creator-led programs.
agentUseSummary: Connect a dedicated customer-owned Circle Admin API v2 token. Agents can inspect reduced Community, Space, Access Group, Post, and member metadata and make exact Space or Access Group membership changes. Post and comment bodies, chat, courses, forms, invitations, member lifecycle, structural administration, bulk actions, Headless member impersonation, and arbitrary API access remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated Admin V2 token in the community's Developers → Tokens page. Relay encrypts it and never exposes it to agents or clients after saving.

blocked.label: Read or write content bodies
blocked.description: Post and comment bodies, course lessons, form submissions, chat messages, live transcripts, files, embeds, and arbitrary rich text are outside V1.

blocked.label: Manage member lifecycle
blocked.description: Inviting, creating, updating, banning, deactivating, deleting, impersonating, or changing member profiles and tags is outside V1.

blocked.label: Administer community structure
blocked.description: Creating, updating, deleting, archiving, or duplicating Communities, Spaces, Space Groups, Access Groups, courses, events, forms, topics, and settings is outside V1.

blocked.label: Run bulk or notification actions
blocked.description: Bulk membership changes, automatic pagination, polling, broadcasts, notifications, invitation links, and workflow-like loops are outside V1.

blocked.label: Read broader member data
blocked.description: Profile fields, SSO identifiers, tags, gamification details, avatars, profile URLs, invitation state, and raw member records are outside V1.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary Circle APIs
blocked.description: Arbitrary endpoints, methods, query parameters, headers, bodies, origins, Headless tokens, member impersonation, and raw responses are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All selected bounded Circle V1 tools run without Relay per-action approval; encrypted token storage, fixed Admin v2 origin, provider authority, bounds, audits, privacy reduction, and system blocks still apply.

providerSetup.blocker: No eligible representative Circle community, dedicated Admin API v2 token, or staging member and Space fixtures were available for live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: A Circle administrator on Business or above creates a dedicated Admin V2 token, enters it in Relay, and verifies exact Community binding, reduced Space and Access Group reads, Post-body and broader-member-field exclusion, Safe approval binding, Dangerous execution, representative Space and Access Group add/remove cycles, quotas, token rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial in staging.

evidence.supports: Circle's Admin API is available on Business and above and is intended for admin-authenticated automations and administrative integrations.
Circle recommends Admin API v2 for new work, documents bounded pagination, and states that new endpoints and updates target v2.
Community admins create type-specific Admin V2 tokens and send them in the Authorization header to fixed app.circle.so Admin v2 routes.
The official OpenAPI document defines Community, Space, Post, Community Member, Access Group, Space Member, and Access Group Member endpoints and schemas used by the typed wrappers.
Spaces are Circle's content and access-gating containers, with public, private, and secret access levels and multiple content types.
Circle documents plan-specific monthly Admin API quotas and rate limiting; Relay never automatically paginates or polls.
Circle's platform terms govern customer and member use and prohibit abusive automated access.
Circle's privacy notice explains Creator and Member data handling and the privacy sensitivity of Community content and member information.
